content.user_title: Design Robust APIs With Pattern Guidance
content.value_statement: API teams often choose REST, GraphQL, or tRPC without clear tradeoffs. This skill guides API style, responses, versioning, auth, rate limits, documentation, and security review.
actual_capabilities: Compares REST, GraphQL, tRPC, WebSocket, and gRPC selection tradeoffs.
Guides REST resource naming, HTTP method choice, and status code usage.
Explains response envelopes, error formats, and pagination strategies.
Covers versioning, authentication, rate limiting, OpenAPI documentation, and GraphQL protections.
Provides a local Python validator for API endpoint best practice checks.
limitations: It gives design guidance, not complete framework implementation.
The validator uses heuristics and cannot prove an API is secure.
Security testing advice requires authorization and clear scope.
tRPC guidance assumes TypeScript clients and backends.

use_cases.title: Choose an API Style
use_cases.description: Select REST, GraphQL, tRPC, WebSocket, or gRPC from project constraints. Compare consumers, data shape, caching, and team skills.

use_cases.title: Standardize API Conventions
use_cases.description: Create shared rules for endpoints, responses, errors, pagination, versioning, authentication, rate limits, and OpenAPI documentation.

use_cases.title: Review API Security Design
use_cases.description: Check authentication, authorization, validation, rate limiting, GraphQL controls, and error handling before launch.

prompt_templates.title: Choose API Style
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose REST, GraphQL, or tRPC for a new API. Ask the key context questions first.

prompt_templates.title: Design REST Endpoints
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my resource model and propose REST endpoints. Include methods, status codes, pagination, and error response guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Plan API Evolution
prompt_templates.scenario: Team preparing a public API roadmap.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an API versioning and documentation plan for a public API. Include migration, changelog, and deprecation guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Audit API Design
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this API design for authentication, authorization, rate limiting, validation, GraphQL risks, and documentation gaps. Assume authorized defensive review.

output_examples.input: I need an API for mobile and web clients with complex dashboard data.
output_examples.output: GraphQL is likely suitable. The review would call out flexible queries, schema design, query limits, and production introspection controls.

output_examples.input: I have user and order resources for a public partner API.
output: REST with OpenAPI is a good default.
Use plural resource names, clear status codes, cursor pagination, auth requirements, and rate-limit headers.

output_examples.input: Review an existing API checklist before launch.
output_examples.output: The skill would produce a launch checklist covering auth, authorization, validation, rate limiting, error handling, and documentation readiness.

best_practices: Start by identifying API consumers and client platforms.
Choose one response and error pattern, then apply it consistently.
Frame security testing as authorized defensive review with clear scope.
anti_patterns: Choosing REST, GraphQL, or tRPC before defining users and constraints.
Returning internal errors or inconsistent response structures to clients.
Testing bypasses or authorization flaws without written authorization.

faq.question: Does this skill implement an API?
faq.answer: No. It guides design choices and reviews. Implementation still depends on your framework and codebase.

faq.question: When should I use REST?
faq.answer: Use REST for public APIs, partner integrations, broad client compatibility, and simple resource operations.

faq.question: When should I use GraphQL?
faq.answer: Use GraphQL when clients need flexible queries across connected data and your team can manage schema security.

faq.question: When should I use tRPC?
faq.answer: Use tRPC for TypeScript full-stack projects, especially monorepos where public API compatibility is not required.

faq.question: Does it include security guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers authentication, authorization, validation, rate limiting, GraphQL controls, and authorized API security testing.

faq.question: Can it validate my project automatically?
faq.answer: It includes a local Python validator for API files, but results are heuristic and need human review.
